map_features.note: Approximate editorial locator points place a name in a recognizable region on the OSW equirectangular map. Points are neither observed cores nor endpoints or length measurements. Multi-basin family names have one point per basin and must be split into separate records before quantitative comparison.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: Northward shelf-break West Greenland branch from an OSW Cape Farewell approach gate to an OSW Davis Strait gate near 67 N. Excludes the separate inshore West Greenland Coastal Current, the westward branch joining Labrador Current, shed Irminger Rings, fjords, upstream East Greenland/Irminger paths and continuation beyond the chosen Davis Strait gate. Not the whole bifurcating West Greenland Current system.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

ordering_sensitivity.interpretation: Conservative positions within retained rounded route envelopes, treating choices independently; touching envelopes overlap. Not a statistical rank interval or a uniform whole-current comparison.
